name: codeworks
description: Read project files, apply patches, change files, and run commands. Use this tool for ALL project access. Read/discussion creates no worktree. First non-documentation write automatically prepares the workspace; all later access uses it. Commands MUST explicitly choose read or write; read has an OS readonly source view, write grants only this workspace. Never retry a partially executed command. poll/stdin address only your own command_id. batch operations: write(path,content), delete(path), rename(path,to), symlink(path,target); patch accepts Codex Begin/End Patch framing. Paths can be repository-relative or absolute base/workspace paths. Identity comes from the runtime, never arguments. Before the first write select kind=feature or hotfix with action=kind; optional element_id/move_id/attempt_id link game-core without changing task state. action=commit requires message and stable request_key; action=request-release requires stable request_key and uses only your current clean HEAD. Git metadata remains inaccessible to commands. Repeat the same request_key after interruption; never substitute a new key blindly.
